audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart hands Gnar four rows the prose explicitly gives to Olaf. whys[0] says Olaf 'farms it back even' but win[0] is Gnar; whys[2] says he sticks to you and you can't kite away but win[2] is Gnar; whys[3] says his slow runs you down but win[3] is Skill; whys[6] says his all-in scales past your burst but win[6] is Gnar. The 47.21% win rate agrees with the prose, not the chart.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Gnar, Olaf, Olaf, Gnar, Skill, Olaf] and matches every why line.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group in both layers; Olaf rows rated 4/10 in lane and 3/10 late, level 1 down to 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer phases were untouched template text and never gave a real cooldown for anything.
audit.why: The spikes that matter are level 2 (Hyper third-hit before he can all-in), levels 3-5 (Undertow online), level 6 gated on Ragnarok, and late. Undertow is 9s flat; Ragnarok is 100/90/80s.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].why rewritten to the real story with Undertow's 9s cooldown and its reset condition stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent. Undertow's cooldown RESETS if Olaf picks the axe back up, so its stated 9 seconds is only real while the axe is lying somewhere he has to walk to; and Tough It Out (W) gives him a shield on top of attack speed, which eats the burst half of a Mega commit.
audit.why: Both are in Riot's own text — 'If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset' and 'Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield'. Neither appears anywhere in the matchup, and the _missing file flags the shield for this exact pairing.
audit.corrected: Axe-pickup reset stated in phases[3].why and dosFull[2].d; the shield stated in dosFull[1].d alongside his missing-health lifesteal passive.

audit.why: The existing text already states the single most important thing correctly: Ragnarok grants disable immunity while he keeps attacking, so Wallop and GNAR! simply do not hold him, and Reckless Swing's true damage ignores Mega's armour. That is right and I left it alone.

edits.before: Boomerang + hop kite wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Olaf contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Mini's ranged autos and one Boomerang win the first poke, but Olaf shrugs off the range and farms it back to even.

edits.before: Rage management is the champion — track your own bar. Only take the trade when Olaf's Ragnarok is down.
edits.after: Third-hit Hyper plus a Boomerang is a free chunk he cannot answer at 2 — take it, then shove the wave.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Olaf must walk into your range.
edits.after: He throws Undertow to slow you, closes on that slow, and sticks to a Mini body that cannot kite away.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ragnarok's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Undertow's 9s cooldown resets when he picks the axe back up — punish only while it lies far from him and Rage is banked.

edits.before: Mega + R against a wall is the best engage top lane owns. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Olaf's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: With Mega up and Ragnarok down, Wallop into wall-GNAR! is your clean kill window — but only while his R is down.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ragnarok's cooldown.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes him CC-immune, so your Wallop stun and GNAR! do nothing while it burns.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Olaf carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Ragnarok's true damage and W lifesteal out-sustain your kiting — his all-in scales past your form burst.

edits.before: Boomerang Olaf's last-hits, AA-hop out of his reach, and time Mega so the transform lands ON his engage window.
edits.after: Executioner's early: Tough It Out shields him and his lifesteal ramps as he drops, so long brawls refill him.

edits.before: Olaf wastes Ragnarok — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Undertow resets if he retrieves it — deny the pickup.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: That slow is what lets him close — step off the axe line early.

notes: The kit file tags Undertow (Q) with grounding, 'shuts off enemy dashes'. Riot's own Q text describes only damage, armour reduction and a move speed slow — no grounding. Per the trust-the-description rule I did NOT write anywhere that Undertow denies Gnar's Hop, and the existing text does not claim it either. Flagging as a probable tooltip-parse misfire. Separately: this matchup's early/mid/late prose is written in the FIRST person ('my Rage bar', 'I can't kite away') while every other Gnar matchup I have audited uses the second person. It is not a factual error so I left the paragraphs intact rather than burn the length band on a voice rewrite, but it needs a pass.
